description: MP-EVData: An AI-Augmented Dataset of Multi-Prototype Electric Vehicle Charging Load Profiles in China is a data set deposited in Figshare by its authors Runlong Liu, Yiyan Li. Large-scale electric vehicle integration poses significant challenges to power grid operation, demanding high-fidelity and diversified datasets for in-depth research. To address this need, we introduce MP-EVData, a dataset of station-level charging load profiles from a major Chinese metropolis, covering the full 2024 year. Coverage: national (CN); the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 27820978 Bytes. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-figshare-repository.
